title: An Efficient and Precise Training Data Construction Framework for Process-supervised Reward Model in Mathematical Reasoning
paper_type_zh: 过程/轨迹监督数据与过程奖励研究

one_line: An Efficient and Precise Training Data Construction Framework for Process-supervised Reward Model in Mathematical Reasoning exposes process or trace supervision data.
提出 EpicPRM 数据构建框架，并公开 Epic50K：通过贡献度标注和自适应二分首错定位生成 5 万条高质量过程监督样本。
why: It makes intermediate reasoning feedback auditable before reuse.
inclusion_reason: Process/trace supervision data release or data-construction method.

title: Problem
问题
html: Open process-supervision data are limited in scale and diversity, constraining PRM training and comparison. EPICPRM asks how to construct a large, quality-controlled collection of step-level reasoning supervision for training and evaluating process reward models.
公开的过程监督数据规模和多样性不足，限制了过程奖励模型的训练与比较。EPICPRM 研究如何构建大规模、经质量控制的步骤级推理监督数据，用于训练和评测过程奖励模型。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: EpicPRM introduces a data-construction framework and releases Epic50K, using precise first-error localisation to obtain cost-effective mathematical step supervision. It builds an error-propagation chain for each candidate solution: after checking the final outcome, it locates the pivotal error and the steps affected by it, avoiding the treatment of consequences as independent errors. It turns the sparse feedback of whether the final answer is correct into a supervision contract that can be localized to the reasoning process. It can therefore support training while revealing the step at which a model begins to diverge.
核心贡献是：提出 EpicPRM 数据构建框架并发布 Epic50K，强调用精确首错定位获得高性价比的数学步骤监督。 数据对象可概括为：框架为候选解答建立错误传播链：先验证终局，再定位关键错误和其后的受影响步骤，避免把“后果”误当作独立错误。 它把“最终答案是否正确”的稀疏反馈改写为可定位到推理过程的监督契约，因而既能服务训练，也能暴露模型在何一步开始偏离。

title: Method
方法
html: Epic50K can train mathematical PRMs and serve as a public benchmark for error localisation, label noise, and data efficiency. During training or use, inputs normally include the problem, an existing trace, and intermediate states; outputs are step labels, comparative preferences, or continuous rewards. The generator, terminal verifier, sampling budget, and filtering rules should be checked separately because together they determine what the labels mean.
方法上，Epic50K 可训练数学 PRM，也可用作检验错误定位、标签噪声与数据效率的公开基准。 训练或使用阶段，Epic50K 可训练数学 PRM，也可用作检验错误定位、标签噪声与数据效率的公开基准。 输入通常包括题目、已有轨迹与中间状态；输出是步骤标签、比较偏好或连续奖励。应分别核验生成器、终局验证器、采样预算与过滤规则，因为它们共同决定标签含义。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The verifiable evidence for “An Efficient and Precise Training Data Construction Framework for Process-supervised Reward Model in Mathematical Reasoning” begins with its 2025 publication record in arXiv. The release is catalogued as a documented feedback resource, and the official record identifies a data release, official code, a project page. These materials establish the provenance and accessibility of the resource described by the paper. They do not by themselves measure a universal improvement: the strength of a reported result depends on the paper’s task distribution, supervision design, model setting, and evaluation protocol. Any comparison of later systems therefore needs to preserve the released data version and the conditions under which the paper’s evidence was collected. The publication and its official artifacts provide the traceable basis for that interpretation and comparison.

《An Efficient and Precise Training Data Construction Framework for Process-supervised Reward Model in Mathematical Reasoning》的可追溯证据首先来自其 2025 年在 arXiv 发表或发布的记录。该发布被归入有文档说明的反馈资源，官方记录标明其提供数据发布、官方代码和项目页。这些材料能够说明论文所述资源的来源和可访问状态，却不能单独度量普遍性能提升。任何结果的力度仍取决于论文采用的任务分布、监督设计、模型设置和评测协议。比较后续系统时，需要保留发布版本以及论文收集证据时的条件。论文和其官方工件共同构成解释这些结果时可回溯的依据，也明确限定了结论能够追溯的材料范围。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Compared with assigning a whole chain of thought a single correct-or-incorrect label, this work changes the unit or acquisition path of process data. EpicPRM introduces a data-construction framework and releases Epic50K, using precise first-error localisation to obtain cost-effective mathematical step supervision. It builds an error-propagation chain for each candidate solution: after checking the final outcome, it locates the pivotal error and the steps affected by it, avoiding the treatment of consequences as independent errors. This is why it belongs in Process and Trace Supervision Data; process rewards themselves are not new, whereas its reusable contribution is the data contract, quality control, and evaluation boundary.
相对把整条 CoT 只标为对或错的做法，该工作改变的是过程数据的采集或使用单位。提出 EpicPRM 数据构建框架并发布 Epic50K，强调用精确首错定位获得高性价比的数学步骤监督。 这也是它进入 Process / Trace Supervision Data 的原因；但“使用过程奖励”本身并非新意，真正应复用的是其数据契约、质量控制与评测边界。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The 50K scale facilitates auditing, but the domain is mainly mathematics; a first-error strategy is sensitive to multiple interdependent errors in long chains. Process scores are auxiliary signals for training or search, not replacements for executable verification, human review, or domain-expert judgment. Before cross-domain use, labels should be sampled and checked to ensure that they still correspond to real errors in the target task.
局限需要与贡献一并阅读：50K 规模便于审计，但领域主要是数学；首错策略对长链条中多个相互依赖错误较敏感。 过程分数是训练或搜索的辅助信号，不能替代可执行验证、人工审核或领域专家判断。跨领域使用前，至少应抽样检查标签是否仍对应目标任务中的真实错误。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For data researchers, the paper is a concrete recipe to compare: state granularity, candidate source, label or preference construction, negative examples, and acceptance criteria. For model builders it can support PRM training, best-of-N reranking, tree search, and trace filtering. For evaluators, first-error localization and calibration matter more than answer accuracy alone.
对数据研究者，最直接的价值是把该工作当成一份可比较的数据配方：明确状态粒度、候选来源、标签或偏好产生机制、负例构造和验收指标。对模型研究者，它可用于 PRM 训练、best-of-N 重排、树搜索和轨迹过滤；对评测者，则应优先报告首错定位与校准而非只报最终正确率。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: A productive reading order is to inspect availability and provenance first, then trace context and label evidence, and only then study the reported gain. Compare the design with PRM800K, rollout-derived labels, and preference-tree supervision. Finally, inspect high-scoring wrong traces to determine whether the verifier learned reasoning quality or superficial style, length, and answer leakage.
阅读时建议先检查数据对象是否可获得、样本是否保留原始上下文、标签是否可追溯到验证证据，再看模型提升。其次比较它与 PRM800K、自动 rollout 标签和偏好树方法的差异。最后手工抽取若干高分错误轨迹，判断奖励模型到底识别了推理质量，还是偏好了格式、长度或答案泄漏。
